metadata.description: dfm (dataflow marketing): marketing skills for Claude that keep a business's marketing context.

plugins.name: dfm-content
plugins.description: Words from the person's own: profile-make makes a checked profile of a site (and on a later read, only what changed); profile-compare shows what changed or puts businesses side by side; market-read keeps a business's site as a ledger read from outside, the way the public sees it; market-report writes the month's report; post-make makes a post from their words; share-make the words to share it on a channel; message-make a message to one person; ideas-make what to make next, from the questions people asked; quotes-check proves every quote, name, number and amount is in its source.

plugins.name: dfm-ghost
plugins.description: Ghost sites: site-add names a site and its key's variable in settings; post-draft puts a checked post on Ghost as a draft and reads it back; numbers-read reads a week's new members and email numbers (sent, opens, clicks); said-read reads what went out that week; fields-change changes one member's custom field, such as an answer to an account question.

plugins.name: dfm-site
plugins.description: Any public website, on any platform: site-add names it in settings with no key; llms-check says whether AI tools can read it; links-check finds links that do not work for a visitor; dfm reads a site and never writes to it.

plugins.name: dfm-recipes
plugins.description: Recipes that run skills in order: client-run sets up a business with a first plan (start here if you are new to dfm); week-run brings in a week, for one business or every business in settings; recording-run turns a recording into a draft post; reply-run deals with messages in; report-run makes a period's report; calendar-run plans posts from what people asked; watch-run reads a market on a schedule, on your own computer; health-run checks a site's health.

plugins.name: dfm-ledger
plugins.description: A business's ledger: plan-make starts one; plan-check names every problem; counts-record adds a week's told numbers; summary-make writes the summary; askai-make makes a copy for any AI chat (askai-here answers it in this session); plan-change takes its Change lines back; weeks-archive moves old weeks into the history when a ledger gets big; inbox-read turns messages in into proposed changes and says what needs a reply; report-make writes a short report for a period.

plugins.name: dfm-store
plugins.description: Where a business's objects are kept: store-add names a store and a binding in settings; store-check proves each can be read; objects-read lists every object of a kind; object-read reads an object with its version; object-add puts one into an empty place; object-change changes it only if no one else has since, with a backup first and a read back after; object-remove empties it, with a backup first. Files and Ghost member fields.

plugins.name: dfm-cloudflare
plugins.description: Site numbers from Cloudflare Web Analytics, read only: visits-read reads a week's visits, views and visits from another site for every fact whose source is cloudflare; dfm-ledger:counts-record records them.
